name: Xiamen Wanli Stone Stock Co.,Ltd
summary: Xiamen Wanli Stone Stock Co.,Ltd engages in the design, processing, sales, and engineering construction of architectural decorative stone and landscape stone. The company offers slab, cut-to-size, countertop, vanity top, windowsill, wall cladding, special shaped stone, garden and landscaping stone, sculpture, monument, slate, prefabricate, mosaic, sink, quartz, granite and marble tile, and faucet products. It operates in China, Japan, South Korea, the United States, South Africa, Algeria, Singapore, the European Union, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
